modules.module_title: Manage health and safety protocols at the workplace

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and personal hygiene- related protocols
coordinate with other designers to identify possible hazards within project designing during construction and subsequent maintenance
analyze the existing health and safety plan or safety line
identify and report poor organizational practices concerning hygiene, food handling, cleaning

undertake first aid activities in case of an accident, if required and asked to do so
communicate necessary control measures to concerned team members
ensure that safety instructions applicable to the work place are being followed

plan and utilize the reusable materials and wastage in the designing process
